column5: Tree-of-thought as search: a problem branches into thoughts rated likely, impossible and sure; the impossible one is pruned, a dead end backtracks, and the sure branch is solved, run by a generator prompt, an evaluator prompt and BFS/DFS search code.

ReAct as a message sequence: the orchestrator sends the question and tools to the LLM, the LLM returns a Thought and Action, the orchestrator validates and runs the tool, appends the untrusted result as an Observation, and loops until a final answer, step limit or repeated action.

Layered prompt-injection defense: direct and indirect untrusted input passes an input classifier, an LLM that labels content as data, output validation with allowlists, least-privilege tools enforced in code and human confirmation, beside the dangerous combination of private data, untrusted content and a way to send data out.

A contract-review prompt chain: a small model extracts clauses, a schema check retries on failure, clauses are classified in parallel, and a high-risk check routes either to a short summary or to a strong-model risk analysis and a memo for legal.

The prompt evaluation loop: run prompt vN on the eval set, score with code, an LLM judge and human labels, cluster failures, change one thing and rerun, with production failures feeding the set and shipping gated on no slice regressing, since a +2 average can hide a -15 slice.

A meta-prompt loop: task and examples feed a meta-prompt that produces candidate prompts, the eval set scores them, scores and failures feed back, and the best prompt is confirmed on a held-out test set; the three uses are draft, critique and optimize.

An output parser pipeline: raw text is extracted, parsed and coerced, then validated; valid output becomes a typed object and invalid output is recovered by retrying with the error, with a worked example turning fenced JSON into an Order object.

Preventing a system-prompt leak: the user reaches an LLM holding only a behavioral prompt through an input classifier, the LLM calls server-side business rules and gets results only, and answers pass an output filter with a canary and overlap check.

Multilingual support as a pipeline of language detection, multilingual retrieval, generation with an explicit output language, per-language guardrails and locale formatting, rolled out one language at a time behind each language's own eval.

Text to vector: text is tokenized, transformer layers produce an n x d matrix of context-aware per-token vectors, pooling reduces it to one vector, and L2 normalization gives a unit-length vector of d dimensions.
IVF approximate nearest neighbor search: the query is compared with every k-means centroid, only the two nearest cells are searched, candidates are merged and the top-k returned.

An embedding-model update as a blue/green migration: serving on index A, backfill index B, shadow live traffic, then cut over with one alias flip, with rollback paths from shadow and from cutover back to A.

CLIP-style multi-modal training: captions and images pass through separate encoders and projections into a batch similarity matrix whose diagonal true pairs are pushed up by a symmetric contrastive loss.

Embedding quantization: 100M x 1536 vectors take 614 GB in float32, 154 GB in int8 and about 9.6 GB with PQ at m = 96, searched as ANN over quantized vectors in RAM, then the top 100-500 candidates rescored with full vectors from disk.

Billion-scale vector search: a coordinator scatters the query to shards holding PQ codes in RAM, merges their candidates and rescores with full vectors, beside the memory math of about 3 TB raw versus 64 GB of PQ codes.

Handling an embedding-drift incident: roll back the alias, diagnose mixed vector spaces and configuration, re-roll with build, offline eval, shadow, canary and atomic cutover gates, then prevent recurrence with mismatch checks, CI evals and alerts.
